ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Execution of InstallUtil Without Log
ruleDefinitions.description: Uses the .NET InstallUtil.exe application in order to execute image without log

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\InstallUtil\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/logfile\\=\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/LogToConsole\\=false.*")))
